Messages.Author: Michael Kelly
Messages.Body:
Shadow Court Satyr (Changeling)
When Shadow Court Satry comes into play, you may put a
combat card from your hand on him. During combat, Satyr may
use the ability of thar card as if that card had been played
from your hand. Yadda, yadda, yadda.

This ally can use the combat card on him as if played. This means
it is not consumed and can be used multiple times, right? What if
the card is a damage prevention card like Skin of Rock? I would think
that the intention is that he could only use it once per combat
but the text does not specify. As it is currently written the
little bugger could use it N times where N is the damage he takes
in a round! Is there any errata or does anyone have another
interpretation?
